summary: V0.5 upgrade verified end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest passing (added 4 V0.5 tests: en/fr mint, instructions graceful fallback, health no key leak). Frontend Playwright: summary bar + 5 status dots render; direction toggle FR->EN/EN->FR swaps summary badge AND transcript panel labels (SOURCE — FRENCH / TRANSLATION — ENGLISH vs SOURCE — ENGLISH / TRANSLATION — FRENCH); all 5 modes (general/sermon/academic/business/custom) select and update summary-mode; custom textarea reveals when CUSTOM; Event Profile dialog opens, fields fill, closes cleanly and summary-event reflects 'Sunday Service'; Audio Setup with TEST INPUT works — status='Live', meter visible, stop button appears, and CRITICALLY no /api/realtime-session POST occurs during test-input; save-transcripts default unchecked (OFF); START with FR->EN + Sermon + profile POSTs to /api/realtime-session with target_language='en' AND non-empty instructions (675 chars) containing 'Sunday Service', 'Holy Spirit', and Sermon mode body ('biblical'); OpenAI returns 429 insufficient_quota (external), app surfaces error-banner and restores START button; export-txt-button triggers download named 'translatebox-Sunday-Service-*.txt'; fullscreen overlay opens/closes; Session Info fields all present; Debug page loads, both tabs work, and DOM contains NO 'sk-'.

integration_issues.issue: 429 insufficient_quota — OpenAI org has no credits. App handles gracefully (error-banner + START restored). Same external blocker as iterations 2/3/4.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning, non-blocking)

action_items: Add credits to the OpenAI org tied to OPENAI_API_KEY (external, no app change).
Optional a11y polish: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Event Profile dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/realtime-session gracefully retries without instructions on 4xx — good: preserves working flow while still exposing instructions_applied boolean to the client.
server.py never logs api_key nor echoes it — verified no 'sk-' in any response body (health + realtime-session).
compileInstructions() correctly composes mode text + direction sentence + event/org + speakers + typed vocab groups + additional. Verified 675-char payload received by backend.
Frontend testInput path routes mic to level meter WITHOUT calling /api/realtime-session — confirmed 0 POSTs during TEST INPUT.
Console renders START/STOP as either-or (JSX toggles on `active`); after 429 the app reverts to inactive so START button reappears. Correct.
Debug page does NOT expose OPENAI_API_KEY anywhere — verified via full-page HTML scan.
V0 regression: FR->EN flow unchanged — start still acquires mic, mints ephemeral (backend returns ek_), and POSTs SDP offer to OpenAI (429 is a live-endpoint failure, wiring is intact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: V0.5 fully wired. Backend adds instructions passthrough with graceful fallback + instructions_applied bool; frontend compiles mode+vocab+event into POST body verified 675 chars. Only external blocker is OpenAI 429 insufficient_quota. When running pytest: `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs)` first because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL lives in frontend/.env. Playwright: to capture the instructions body, attach page.on('request') filter for '/api/realtime-session' before clicking start-translation-button. Radix dialog needs wait_for_timeout(300-400) after open before filling profile-* fields.
rca of the issue: No app-side issue. External OpenAI 429 insufficient_quota is the only failing outcome, and the app handles it gracefully (error-banner shown, PC torn down, START restored). Mitigation: fund the OpenAI org.
